articles.title: Bitcoin layer-2s face a bear-market reality check
articles.snippet: Botanix's shutdown has raised an uncomfortable question for Bitcoin builders: Does the market actually want programmable BTC, or just a better way to borrow, lend and earn yield on it?

articles.title: Bitcoin capitulation ‘twice as weak’ after spot liquidity turns supportive: Glassnode
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s realized losses fell by 46% as increasing bid-side liquidity points to easing sell pressure. Can bulls push BTC price back above $70,000?

articles.title: Nvidia Built Robots That Train Themselves Using AI Coding Agents
articles.snippet: Nvidia's ENPIRE hands an entire robot fleet to coding agents like Codex and Claude Code, letting them write training code, test it on real hardware, and improve without a human watching.
